newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Karachi bourse halts morning session.
newsitem.headline: Karachi bourse halts morning session.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) halted its morning session on Friday after the death of a member, a KSE spokesman said.
"There will be no trading today in the morning because of the demise of our member A.G. Mohammad. But a special budget session will be held in the evening," the spokesman said.

Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz is due to present the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June) budget from 5:30 p.m. (1230 GMT) when the special session will start. It will end one hour after he ends his speech to the National Assembly (lower house).
